## Requirements

- **FR-001** (test): When the user saves, the editor shall show a message.
- **FR-002** (test): The editor shall save the title and the editor shall close.
- **FR-003** (test): When the user saves, editor shall show a message.
- **FR-004**: The editor shall save the title.
- **FR-005** (test): While the keyboard is open, when the user taps, the form shall scroll.
